title: My Niece Forged A Sale, Sold My Business. So I Watched Her Wear 'Packed With Lies'.
description: A nurse's entire pension was drained by a niece who promised 40% ownership, forged documents, and sold the storage business for $620K, leaving only a $3,000 finder's fee. The betrayal unraveled when a discarded logbook exposed the fraud, leading to a court victory, a renamed facility 'Unit of Betrayal Storage,' and a humiliating vest reading 'Packed with Lies.' #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #Karma
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE SALE, NOW WEARS PACKED WITH LIES
pinned_comment: What would you do if a family member drained your entire pension, forged documents, and sold your business for $620K, leaving you with a $3,000 finder's fee? Share your story in the comments if you've ever been betrayed by someone you trusted.

thumb_lines.text: I DUG THE LOGBOOK FROM A DUMPSTER
